comments.author: carlos-mendez
comments.text: Tab bar navigation (FORGE-30) is merged and in TestFlight. Four tabs: Home, Tasks, Notifications, Profile. Matches the sprint planning spec.

comments.author: yuki-designer
comments.text: Following the exec UX review on Monday, we are pivoting away from the tab bar to a gesture-based navigation model — full-screen swipe between sections, with a persistent floating action button for primary actions. This reverses the tab bar decision from sprint planning. The new spec is in frames 'Nav/Gesture-v2/*'. I know FORGE-30 just shipped — flagging this as a priority rework for Sprint 10. The gesture model scored significantly higher in the executive stakeholder session and aligns with the broader product direction. FORGE-38 has been created to track.

comments.author: mei-tanaka
comments.text: This is the first engineering has heard of this decision. We need a sync before any rework starts — FORGE-36 and FORGE-26 are both built on the current nav structure.

title: iOS Widget Design Kit — Small & Medium

raw.file_name: iOS Widget Design Kit — Small & Medium

comments.author: yuki-designer
comments.text: Small widget finalized — task count and next due item. Text truncation spec: max 2 lines for task title, ellipsis. Background uses WidgetKit adaptive tinting.

comments.author: mei-tanaka
comments.text: Implemented per spec. One edge case: 47mm Apple Watch face clips the 'next due' label at 20 chars. Created follow-up ticket.

comments.author: yuki-designer
comments.text: Swipe-right = archive (green), swipe-left = delete (red). Haptic spec: light on reveal, medium on completion. Both actions confirmed in FORGE-33.

comments.author: carlos-mendez
comments.text: Implemented. Haptics match spec exactly. One note: on iOS 17, the delete action requires a confirmation tap — added a secondary 'Confirm Delete' reveal per HIG guidelines.

title: Offline Mode — UX States & Sync Indicators

raw.file_name: Offline Mode — UX States & Sync Indicators

comments.author: yuki-designer
comments.text: Offline banner: amber bar at top of screen with 'Offline — viewing cached data' copy. Sync in-progress state: spinning indicator in nav bar. Sync complete: brief green check animation. All states in frames 'Offline/*'.

comments.author: carlos-mendez
comments.text: Note: the sync indicator placement in the nav bar conflicts with the tab bar — if we pivot to gesture nav (per the Nav Architecture file comment), this will need to be revisited. Holding implementation until nav decision is locked.
